verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a front-end assessment artifact with a Release 1 recommendation.
The client defines the audit scope and concrete acceptance content, including evidence-backed findings, risk analysis, remediation estimates, and explicit boundaries.
The client unambiguously accepts the proposed written format and file-and-line evidence requirement for the audit artifact.
First target-specific completion claim for the audit, identifying the delivered report, findings register, evidence, remediation sequence, and assumptions and exclusions.
The client narrows the assessment artifact to the Connector Module and requires it to be packaged separately.
Target-specific post-modification completion claim for the corrected report pack and evidence bundle covering the requested Connector Module-focused work.
